topic.title: Keys Search
topic.shortdesc: Use the Keys tab to search for available DITA keys and insert references to them.

body.p: The Keys tab within the Workspace Search view allows you to see all DITA keys defined in the context publication. Depending on the type of resource, you can insert key references, open the key definition location, open the resource, and insert links or related links.
The Keys tab contains the following options and features:

dlentry.dd: Use this field to filter keys by searching based on their name or contents.

dd.p:
Each found key in the resulting list can either have keyword content or can refer to resources (topics, images, web links). Depending on the key type, while hovering over a result, additional actions become available in top-right corner of the result:
Open key target location - Opens the document in the visual editor.
Open key definition location - Opens the resource where the key definition is located.
Actions to insert key references in the current document:
Insert as phrase reference - Inserts a key reference.
Insert as link - Inserts a link to the local or web resource referenced by the key.
Insert as related link - Inserts a related link to the local or web resource.
Insert image reference - Insert an image key reference if the key refers to an image resource.
Insert figure reference - Insert a figure containing inside an image key reference if the key refers to an image resource.
Insert video reference - Insert a DITA object with a key reference if the key refers to a video resource.
Insert audio reference - Insert a DITA object with a key reference if the key refers to an audio resource.
